horoscope: Early today, you more readily see the flaws in plans and relationships, dear Aries, but perhaps too much so temporarily. However, transits pull you quickly and nicely out of this state. In fact, you can find that things are naturally falling back into place. Somebody may be looking up to you for your wisdom, or people seem more compassionate, interested, and sympathetic to your cause, in general. You express yourself comfortably and creatively. A Sun-Uranus sextile influences the later part of the day, helping open you up and improving flexibility. Your unique perception, advice, or viewpoint can be on display. Detaching from a situation just a little enables you to get perspective. There can be fun developments or progress related to creative play and expression.

It becomes easier to detach yourself from annoyances today, dear Taurus, and as you pan out, you can arrive at wonderful insights. The Sun is encouraging you to tend to your hearth these days, and today, things may seem a little easier close to home. Your inner world, home life, and family are in the spotlight and at the top of your priorities list. Never underestimate just how much this builds your confidence. While you might be encouraged to do some inner exploration today, there can be a sense of satisfaction with things as they are for the time being. Do what you can to connect with the part of you that has faith that things will work out well. Support might come from family, and there can be strongly sentimental feelings experienced today. Your imagination takes you to inventive places now, and you can thoroughly enjoy thinking up new plans or methods in and around the home and with business. Drawing up new techniques or using different and inspired methods to approach your family life, money, or regular routines can be successful and fun.

Ideally, minor discouragements now lead to important improvements that benefit you greatly, dear Gemini. Fortunately, today's Sun transits help with this greatly. Your intuitive perceptions are strong, and your forgiving, merciful side is in full force, particularly in the first half of the day. There can be a good feeling generated when you help others. While you may be a little spaced out or you could have difficulties concentrating, this is a good time for giving your brain a break. You might look back on situations with more faith and kindness, and this can give you some peace and freedom from worry. A Sun-Uranus transit coming into influence can point you in the direction of inspiration. Something or someone stirs your higher ideals and awakens your dreams. You're in great shape for interactions with a sibling or acquaintance, news that helps you, and generally a feeling of moving forward, if not a breakthrough. You can delight in some inspiring ideas and a sense of progress. Gaining surprise freedoms or discovering new ways of doing things can figure strongly now.

While there can be worries or problem areas surfacing very early today, dear Cancer, today's transits quite quickly turn these into opportunities. You might enjoy a looser schedule and prefer to set your own pace. In fact, it can be a great time to let go of any tendencies to control things in your life. This is the way toward increased personal power! There can be wonderful inspiration and imagination now, particularly surrounding business and finances. You might find that plans and insights come together quite beautifully, or you may enjoy a good feeling of confidence and wonderfully creative and compassionate energy in your professional or public dealings. You might arrive at fantastic new ideas or methods, and you may benefit from exploration and non-routine activities. There may be a breakthrough of sorts that inspires you.

While there can be some complicated feelings to sort through early today, dear Leo, transits quickly and nicely help you process and free your thinking. You are likely to receive some form of positive boost or lifting of spirits. Your imagination is strong, and you are able to see beyond the ordinary right now. The Sun in your sign connects harmoniously with dreamy, inspiring, and imaginative Neptune, and then with rule-breaking, intuitive Uranus. Perplexing problems now seem less daunting, perhaps because your faith that things will work out for the best is strengthening. You may be drawing up some admiration from others. You have a little more courage to express yourself or break free from stereotypes and routines, which feels good. You could be on the same page as a significant someone or feel strongly about a group endeavor and teamwork. It's an active time for positivity and hopefulness, and enjoying friends or networks and different, unusual ideas.

You may have faced some doubts, dear Virgo, but you're building your faith in yourself with the help of strong Sun transits. Behind-the-scenes matters tend to go very well for you right now, and you may begin to see a grand design behind recent events in your life. Your intuition is running high. Aim to pay attention to coincidences and make note of subtle signs and patterns. Letting go of analyzing things too much, overthinking, and other patterns that are not working for you is freeing now. It becomes quite natural to pan out. You might enjoy a sudden inspiration and intuition that boosts your career, reputation, or long-term goals. You're feeling positive and opening your mind to new approaches that can be truly valuable. There can be workarounds to problems that save you time or lead to other developments. You need to put ego issues aside, as you sense that something larger or more important needs consideration. Use this time to re-evaluate your life and where you are going.

You have a particular need to be involved, contribute, and feel connected these days, dear Libra, and you can be more sensitive than usual if others are self-absorbed. However, today's transits remind you of the benefits of letting things flow. Inspiration may be found through a special someone or from a relationship. You may be putting more faith in a person, which can be rewarding, as long as you're not putting more faith in a dream of a person. Do what you can on your side to help others build their faith in you, and follow your impulses to help and support others for best results now. Friendships and networks might also inspire or calm you. You're more in touch with your unique qualities and talents than usual, and it's far easier to rise above worries. A Sun-Uranus transit stirs your inner inventor. You have emotional fuel for enjoying and pursuing your interests, and you're likely to thoroughly enjoy trying new things, branching out, improvising, and experimenting. You might be a guide to someone with your balanced perspective.

Today can begin with some tension, dear Scorpio, but you quite naturally begin to see the value of panning out and enjoying the moment. In fact, there can be some fantastic moments of inspiration and a sense of advancement. A nice change in your routine can pull up the need to improvise, which can be fun or lead to interesting detours. You may come to a sense of peace today, particularly as a career move or idea can come together in your mind. It's a good time for dreaming up new and very creative ways to further your goals. Putting a unique and imaginative spin on practical matters comes naturally today. Your imagination is vivid, and you're more tuned in to altruistic purposes in your life even though material affairs can demand your attention more than usual these days. A Sun-Uranus harmonious aspect can point the way to channels for expressing yourself. Innovative methods for doing business or advancing your goals can pop up now.

Disappointments can lead to a sense of release and healing today, dear Sagittarius, and workarounds or life hacks today can be inventive. You might see an opportunity you missed in the past, especially related to a relationship. You need to free your mind to enjoy today's transits, so slight deviations to plans may result in interesting detours. Transits are favorable for personal appeal, friendships, and new things to learn or engage your mind. You are more creative, and your perceptions are especially refined right now. Your personal appeal is boosted as a result. Concentrating on the bigger picture can bring much joy today as you let go of a tendency to overthink. Forgiveness and compassion can be very healing, whether you're giving or receiving it. This is a time when dreams can come true, or a time when dreams that shape later realities are born.

You can be a little touchy in the first half of the day, dear Capricorn. People who disagree with you or don't share your values can get to you more than usual. However, the day's energies quickly turn around. Interesting news or conversations can surround recent research, finances, or intimate relationships. There is dreamy, imaginative energy with you now. When it comes to working towards your dreams, start little and then build upon it so that you don't burn out. You can feel quite inspired today, and family or domestic matters may be integral to this feeling. Showing compassion and understanding does wonders now. You might also discover a new method or idea for making life a little easier, especially as the day advances. You could uncover a new interest, product, or activity that excites you. Transits encourage you to think outside the box and learn new things. Aim to dig deep, research, and keep an open mind.

Very early today, people can be more critical or harbor negative expectations, dear Aquarius. There can be a lot of focus on a relationship or what a partner has to say, but perhaps more than is healthy. However, energies turn around quickly and nicely. The Sun harmonizes with Neptune and then Uranus, helping loosen you up. You're in great shape for enjoying something you read or sharing your thoughts. A partner or special friend may give you just the kind of perspective you need to enjoy yourself more fully. Taking a pause from overdoing and overthinking can be very refreshing now! Getting over a soft spot helps you appreciate the freeing energy of these transits. Personal attraction is strong as these planets fall in your romantic and partnership sectors. There is a spirit of freedom and acceptance in love and friendship now, and a sense that you can be yourself rounds out your mood. It's easier to express yourself creatively and spontaneously.

You could feel that you need to get over a hump before moving ahead, dear Pisces, and today's transits help you do this. It's a good idea to listen to your strong intuition today regarding practical matters, which can come together almost magically. You are content being of service to others today, and while recognition would be nice, you are not actively seeking appreciation. A strong element of compassion and faith can do wonders now. There can be an appreciation of the little things in your daily life that fills you with good feelings. Some aspects of your work, services, or support can lift your spirits today. You might enjoy activities that remind you of the beauty of the moment or those that bring intrinsic rewards. Look for ways to boost spiritual well-being as the Sun and Neptune harmonize. With this energy, you gain personal power by letting go of tension or attempts to maneuver and control events. With the Sun and Uranus also harmonizing, you're in great shape for new ideas, technology, methods, and approaches related to your work and health routines. This can be a time for a sweet release from recent stresses or concerns through your domestic or work activities or through a better approach to healing. Favored most now are activities that support growth and play to your sense of invention and progress. You want to renovate, update, or innovate in some small way, and it's a good time to breathe new life into old projects or routines, or reorganize in unique, helpful ways.
